description: Given a list of generic drug names, say which ones have a curated drug–gene record, with which genes and what each record rests on (a CPIC or DPWG guideline, a drug label, or the primary literature), and which are not covered. Needs no genotype.
name: check_medications
title: Screen a medication list

description: List the genes in the DeepDNA knowledge base, with a one-line summary and category for each.
name: list_genes
title: List genes

description: Pharmacogenomic guidance for a gene, optionally for one drug: guideline (CPIC or DPWG, "drug label", or null when the record rests on the primary literature), summary of the recommendation, phenotypes and sources. Omit drug to list every drug curated for that gene.

drug.description: Generic drug name, e.g. clopidogrel. Optional.

name: lookup_drug_gene
title: Look up drug–gene guidance

description: Everything curated about one gene: function, key variants with rsIDs, metabolizer or function phenotypes, drug interactions, what a consumer genotyping array can and cannot tell you, and sources.

symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol, e.g. CYP2C19. Case-insensitive.

name: lookup_gene
title: Look up a gene

description: One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources. Send the rsID only, never the user's genotype. A single variant is not a phenotype or metabolizer status.
name: lookup_variant
title: Look up a variant
